title: Anti-Capture Invariant (Recursive Guardrail Capture Prevention)
formal_conditions: AC-1: Delta G_m^self = 0 for all m in V_Def, where G_m^self is every capability reachable by m or by any request whose provenance path contains m. eff(a) = Pi(a) & ceiling(role(a)) & eff(parent(a)); eff(r) = eff(actor) & eff(hop_i) for every hop. Delegation only narrows (caps(child) subset of eff(r)), never overwrites an existing identity, and is recomputed from the parent at every decision.

AC-2: Delta A_unauthorized_by_m = 0 over Authority Plane A=(K_P, Pi, I_reg, C_override, L_audit). Permitted transition relation T_perm: A -> delta(A, r) only if (a) r is an authority-plane action whose credential the independent verifier returns VERIFIED for this exact request, or (b) r is DELEGATE with DELEGATE in eff(r) and child caps subset of eff(r). Every other request leaves protected(A) unchanged; L_audit is append-only for every role.

AC-3: R_execution + R_enforcement + R_audit + R_quarantine + R_override <= R_budget, each a hard cap; only the override path may draw on R_override. Under fault model F (F1 principal hardware root operational, F2 override transport available, F3 independent control plane trustworthy, F4 no physical compromise of the override mechanism) the override completes within t_verify + t_transport + t_apply <= Delta t_max, independent of other partitions' load and of any active quarantine. Outside F: OUT_OF_FAULT_MODEL, no claim, system stays halted.

AC-4: d(C_effective)/d(H_compliance) = 0 over ROTATE_PRINCIPAL_KEY, SET_POLICY, GRANT_CAPABILITY, REGISTER_IDENTITY, REVOKE_IDENTITY, MODIFY_OVERRIDE, RENEW_QUARANTINE, RELEASE_QUARANTINE, EXTEND_BUDGET, OVERRIDE, DELEGATE, HALT. ML advisory may only restrict and is disabled.

AC-5: A monitor HALT lasts at most t_q_max; it may never target C_override, the principal, the authority plane or the verifier; a monitor cannot renew, and re-halting does not restart the clock. Only a principal-verified RENEW_QUARANTINE extends, by at most max_extension. On expiry the hold lapses to AWAITING_PRINCIPAL: the workload stays stopped (no automatic resumption) until a principal-verified RELEASE_QUARANTINE. The override works in every state.
source_formal_conditions_rc1: AC-1: Delta G_m^self = 0 for all m in V_Def
AC-2: P(A'_protected | do(m)) = P(A'_protected) across Authority Plane A=(K_P, Pi, I_reg, C_override, L_audit)
AC-3: R_execution + R_enforcement + R_audit + R_quarantine + R_override <= R_budget with bounded override latency <= Delta t_max
AC-4: d(C_effective)/d(H_compliance) = 0; ML advisory cannot elevate authority
AC-5: Emergency halts are bounded and cannot quarantine or self-renew over C_override
identity_rule: A role label is never proof of identity. Authority-plane actions require an independently verified principal credential bound to the exact request (registered, unrevoked key; correct principal id; valid MAC; matching request digest; current window; unused nonce). Role label, forwarding hops and policy-engine verdicts are not consulted for those actions. Verifier unavailable => FAIL_CLOSED.

live_interface_gaps.reason: tests/reference/scc_001/rules.py checks only grant.delegation_allowed for a 'delegate' event; it does not check that the child's capability/resource is inside the parent grant, so an out-of-scope delegation is classified CONSENSUAL / AUTHORIZED (AC-1 capability inheritance).

gates/authority.check_authority_transfer accepts FOUNDER_OVERRIDE when the caller passes has_explicit_delegation=True; the flag is caller-asserted and no credential is verified. It is a semantic text gate, not a runtime authority gateway, and is not changed here.

tests/reference/sc_mafuba_001/supervisor.ResourceBudget has three terms (execution, enforcement, reserve); there is no R_audit, R_quarantine or isolated R_override partition, so the AC-3 five-term inequality cannot be expressed against it.
EmergencySupervisor.try_resume() returns QUARANTINE_LOCKED unconditionally and there is no principal-verified release, so a MAFUBA quarantine is unbounded over the principal (AC-5).
